title: Prospective Mediator-Class Activation Field & Context-Gated Preference-Susceptibility Transport, Pre-Intervention Search-Ecology Conditioning, Class-Effect Onset/Extinction Boundary Reconstruction, Engine×World Regime Partition, Held-Out Activation Prediction, Q0-Fiber Authority Routing & Contrastive Explanation Scope Experiment
origin_lock: Why does an engine prefer one near-equal legal move over another beyond obvious tactical dominance?

primary_outcome.definition: A_f(e,x)=1 iff FULL_CLASS support differs from BASE support under the frozen three-arm TARGET/SUBSET/SHAM near-equal support protocol.
primary_outcome.note: Activation is a parent class-effect endpoint. Q0-fiber outcomes are downstream and excluded from activation-field discovery.

genealogy_boundary.g95_p2: Context-indexed singleton ROOT_CHANGE transport. P22 does not predict singleton exact-event outcomes or use intervention-response fiber identity.
genealogy_boundary.g10_p10: Opportunity/addressability cartography. P22 may use pre-intervention opportunity/load coordinates but its endpoint is realized class-effect activation, not addressability or certificate opportunity.
genealogy_boundary.g10_p13: Source-conditioned cross-engine defect activation. P22 targets within-engine mediator-class activation and held-out activation prediction, not engine-pair opportunity-transition disagreement.
genealogy_boundary.p21: Q0 representation survives development; P22 asks when the parent class intervention is active before Q0 authority is queried.

development_authority.use: Model/rival development only; all intervention labels are already historical/open.
development_authority.internal_validation: Leave-one-ecology-out diagnostics are descriptive model-selection support only and cannot create transport authority.

forbidden_features: source/event identity as a predictive feature

frozen_rivals.claim: Activation is primarily support-threshold proximity; search ecology adds no transportable information.
Pre-intervention mediator opportunity/load adds activation information beyond threshold proximity.
Chess/search-world context defines activation regimes beyond boundary and carrier load.
Activation transport requires engine-conditioned regime terms.

model_class.primary: Small depth-limited decision rule/decision tree with deterministic tie-breaks, max_depth=3, min_leaf=4.
model_class.secondary: Penalized logistic model on the same frozen feature block for calibration diagnostics only.
model_class.selection: Choose the simplest rival whose leave-one-ecology-out balanced accuracy improves by >=0.10 over all simpler rivals and whose positive-class recall is nonzero in at least two historical ecologies containing positives. Otherwise retain the simpler rival.

support_gate.family_requirement: At least one family must have >=4 positives; family-specific models are allowed only if both families independently meet >=4 positives.

heldout_confirmation.source_selection: New exact-world-disjoint ecology/ecologies chosen and frozen after development model freeze but before held-out FULL_CLASS outcomes.
heldout_confirmation.endpoint: Predict activation/abstention from BASE-only features, seal predictions, then open FULL_CLASS outcomes.
heldout_confirmation.hold: No positive activation occurs in held-out support, or active-cell/sample minima fail.
heldout_confirmation.fail: Held-out positives exist with adequate support but frozen activation field misses the pass thresholds.

q0_authority_routing.rule: Q0-fiber causal explanations may be queried only in cells predicted ACTIVE by the frozen P22 activation field and only where P21/P22 downstream evidence separately licenses the fiber.
q0_authority_routing.inactive: Return ABSTAIN_PARENT_CLASS_INACTIVE; do not attempt fiber-level mechanism attribution.

closure_logic.PASS: A frozen activation field transports prospectively under held-out thresholds and yields an authority-routing rule.
closure_logic.PARTIAL_PASS: Development activation field is identifiable and held-out discrimination is mixed but above random in a bounded subset/family.
closure_logic.FAIL: Adequate held-out positive support exists but frozen activation field fails prospective prediction.
closure_logic.HOLD: Development support is inadequate or held-out positive activation/support is absent.

claim_ceiling: Activation prediction is query-specific to the frozen support definition and node/search protocol.
Pre-intervention predictors are licensing variables, not automatically causal mechanisms.
Engine identity may enter only in R3 after simpler rivals are tested.
No human cognition, objective chess truth or Elo-strength ordering.
